_comment: Gates in `check:static` that the CI static-gates job does NOT run, each with the reason. Not a skip list: tests/check-static-ci-parity.test.mjs fails when a gate is in neither `check:static:ci` nor here, when an entry is not in `check:static`, or when a reason is empty. They still run in the local pre-push hook.

localOnly.arch:coverage-gate: Reads .audit-loop/domain-deps-observed.json, the observed import graph derived from the local database (gitignored, regenerated by arch:refresh). A CI checkout cannot have it; with ARCH_COVERAGE_REQUIRE_ENVELOPE=1 it would fail on every PR, without it it would exit 0 having read nothing.
localOnly.upstream:reconcile:gate: Store-backed: reads the upstream-issue ledger against the cloud audit store and a per-store ledger identity. CI has no store DSN (public repo, no secrets), so it cannot measure; it fails closed on an unresolved base and would otherwise report on a store it cannot reach.
